text:
emily.chen: Quick sync re: CipherBridge marketplace pilot — kickoff Tues 9:30am PT. Main ask: SAML SSO + SCIM provisioning + HSM-backed KMS integration. Can we confirm surface area?
devin.kumar: We can do SAML (IdP initiated + SP-initiated). Need partner's ACS URL and x509 cert. For SCIM we support 2.0 with custom attrs. I will request their attribute list.
indra: Important: CipherBridge uses vendor HSM with KMIP and exposes PKCS#11 for their on-prem. For cloud marketplace/hosted we agreed to BYOK + wrapped key approach. Need legal signoff for key escrow exceptions.
sam_ops: Hosted flow: envelope encryption + partner-wrapped key (partner retains wrapping key). Private flow: direct KMIP/PKCS#11 integration via our HSM adapter. I'll note an ops runbook for rotation and zero-downtime.
kelly_pm: Pilot objectives: (1) SSO login success for SAML and OIDC fallback, (2) SCIM create/update for 150 test accounts, (3) KMS rotate without service interruption, (4) secrets sync with their SecretsBridge. Plan window 2 weeks in us-west.
emily.chen: Also need observability: per-rotation audit events, SCIM provisioning audit, and token-level latency for login. Add to acceptance criteria.
partners-bot: Created pilot folder: https://confluence.redwood/cipherbridge-pilot (auto) :white_check_mark:
devin.kumar: SCIM extension note: they want urn:cipher:employee_role and urn:cipher:line_manager. Example mapping: ```{"userName":"emails[0].value","urn:cipher:employee_role":"role","urn:cipher:line_manager":"managerEmail"}``` I will upload test fixture.
indra: On adapter: propose "hsm-adapter-v1" that exposes KMIP to our runtime but translates calls to PKCS#11 for partner devices. Keep adapter optional to not block Hosted.
sam_ops: Action items:
 - Generate test tenant + SAML metadata for partner  emily.chen
 - SCIM sample payload + fixtures  devin.kumar
 - HSM adapter spike + perf estimates  eng-runtime (assign post-kickoff)
 - Legal BYOK checklist + data flow diagram  legal/crypto (kelly to ping)
Target: initial spikes and fixtures by next Thursday.
kelly_pm: I'll add the pilot timeline to the marketplace launch doc and coordinate announcement cadence. We should avoid public joint announcement until pilot wraps and we have compliance signoff.
emily.chen: Also coordinate SI smoke test endpoints we expose: /scim/v2/Users (POST/GET), /sso/saml/acs, /kms/wrap, /kms/rotate. I'll draft minimal endpoint contract and share.
devin.kumar: One more: fallback if adapter fails — we should support partner-managed wrap key and disable auto-rotate. Add rollback steps in runbook.
indra: Note for eng: PKCS#11 drivers vary by vendor; vendor testing matrix required. I'll email CipherBridge for driver details and sample PKCS#11 lib.
emily.chen: Great. Kickoff invites going out now. See you Tue. :rocket:
